basis: Insight’s August 1 earnings release was the earliest qualifying communication found. Its consolidated statements of operations report total net sales of $2,161,662,000 for the three months ended June 30, 2024, versus $2,349,596,000 for the same quarter of 2023. Actual sales were $70,454,200 below the $2,232,116,200 threshold, a year-over-year decline of approximately 8.00%. Both amounts are reported consolidated GAAP figures, including acquired businesses for the periods Insight owned them.

coverage.detail: February 15, preceding earnings cycle. Slide 22 gave full-year 2024 assumptions for gross profit growth, gross margin and adjusted diluted EPS. Slide 21 discussed SADA’s seasonal adjusted EBITDA. Neither supplied a Q2 consolidated sales ceiling.

March 5, Raymond James conference. The CFO discussed the prior year’s 12% revenue decline and reiterated the February full-year gross profit and margin outlook. The 12% figure referred to 2023 actuals.
May 2, Q1 earnings release. Insight raised full-year adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $10.60–$10.90. Its outlook supplied no numeric range for Q2 consolidated net sales.

May 2, Q1 presentation. Slide 16 compared the May and February full-year assumptions. Both called for mid-to-high-teens gross profit growth and approximately 19% gross margin. These annual assumptions do not establish a Q2 sales upper bound.

May 2, earnings call. In response to a question about the earnings beat and annual guidance, management expected Q2 and Q4 to make more similar contributions to the year. It also discussed Q2 cash-flow timing and infrastructure bookings. None of those remarks quantified consolidated Q2 sales.

May 15, financing announcement. The $500 million figure was the proposed principal amount of senior notes. The companion pricing release and May 20 indenture concerned the same borrowing. The May 21 annual-meeting 8-K reported voting results.
May 21, J.P. Morgan conference. Management described strong prior-year infrastructure comparisons through Q3 and an easier Q4 comparison. It gave no numeric Q2 consolidated sales ceiling.
June 4, Stifel conference. The CEO and CFO discussed cloud and services as a share of gross profit, demand and longer-term strategy. Their remarks supplied no numeric Q2 consolidated sales ceiling.
July 18, after quarter-end. Insight announced an August 1 premarket release and a 9 a.m. ET call. The notice contained no preliminary sales figure.
August 1, issuer-published actuals. The quarterly total net sales row gives 2,161,662 versus 2,349,596 in thousands of dollars. The separate six-month columns show a 3% decline.

publication_date_evidence: Insight’s investor-relations release displays August 1, 2024. Its SEC Exhibit 99.1 carries the same dateline and says Insight reported results that day for the quarter ended June 30. EDGAR accepted the earnings 8-K at 08:08:06 on August 1, before the scheduled 9 a.m. ET call.
